plugins.name: feature-flow-lite
plugins.description: A subagent pipeline for features and fixes: Opus writes the acceptance criteria and has them checked against the request, Haiku investigates, builds and simplifies, and a panel of Opus gatekeepers red-teams the change and decides when it is mergeable.

plugins.name: figma-flow
plugins.description: Turn Figma frames into React that matches them: a skill that lints the frame, looks, then measures; a setup skill that prepares a repo for it; and a mod that saves Figma exports to disk and holds commits until the measurement passes.

plugins.name: heavy-limiter
plugins.description: One machine-wide pool of cores and memory for heavy commands (cargo, go test, Playwright, jest, vitest, tsc, builds), so parallel sessions take turns instead of running out of memory.
